subject: E-Commerce
title: Micro-Entrepreneurship Platforms
description: A fast breakdown of Micro-Entrepreneurship Platforms for builders.

hook.text: Printful, Gelato, and Spring let anyone sell custom products with zero inventory. You design; they print and ship.

buildup.text: Print-on-demand means a product is only made when someone orders it. No upfront cost, no unsold stock, no warehouse.

discovery.text: Creators sell custom merchandise to their audiences. A YouTuber with 10K followers can launch a merch store solo.

twist.text: Margins are razor-thin: 10-20% per sale. The platforms keep most of the revenue for manufacturing and shipping.

climax.text: Print-on-demand democratized selling physical products. Anyone can start, but few make meaningful income from it.

quiz.question: What is the main drawback of print-on-demand for sellers?
options: Razor-thin margins of 10-20% because the platform keeps most of the revenue
